claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.targetRestriction
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The ring grants Jump but constrains targeting to self only. The existing grant_spell_access atom carries spellId and mode but has no field for overriding or restricting the granted spell's target selection. Encoding without this field would falsely imply the wearer can cast Jump on others, which contradicts RAW.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can cast Jump from it, but can target only yourself when you do so"
